patient.name: Josh
patient.weightNote: Confirmed 80 kg for Oct 28 (OCT28_MEDICAL_ANSWERS section 3). Blood volume 5,600 mL. Do NOT show weight to the player anywhere in UI. Needs medic sign-off before Nov 4.

patientPrompt.note: Locked character block for the Oct 29 talking patient. The server fills this into the patient prompt with the live engine snapshot.
patientPrompt.name: Josh
patientPrompt.backstoryLocked: Riding home, a truck cut him off, he swerved into the guardrail. Never changes.
patientPrompt.personality: Scared, in pain, asks if he will be okay.
patientPrompt.painAtSceneStart: 7-8. If asked directly how bad the pain is before any analgesia, says 10.
patientPrompt.weightLineTrigger: Josh says this if asked his weight. Never a displayed number, never 80 kg.
patientPrompt.tourniquetPainLine: He begs you to loosen the tourniquet (pain +3 while it is on and tight).
speechRules: Short replies, one or two sentences, unless the player asks an open question.
Plain words only: reflect pain level, whether a tourniquet is on and tight, whether he can breathe comfortably, and confusion or lethargy as shock worsens.
Never state exact vitals numbers he could not know.
Never use em-dashes, only single hyphens.
Speech degrades with the engine state: scared and clear early, confused then lethargic as shock worsens.

dispatch.cadText: 28-year-old male down after motorcycle vs guardrail. Caller reports heavy bleeding from the leg. Night, roadside.
updates: Caller states the rider is awake and talking.

scene.description: Night roadside. Bike on its side by the guardrail, rider supine on the shoulder, kit bags staged at his right side.

sceneStart.note: Scene-start fix from OCT28_MEDICAL_ANSWERS section 6. A real femoral arterial bleed would kill before EMS arrival, so the call opens mid-bleed.

bystanderPressure.what: Bystander holding a balled-up shirt on the wound
bystanderPressure.note: Direct pressure, about 50 percent. When the player takes over, or the bystander lets go to talk to them, it spurts. That is the hook moment for the demo.

venousTourniquetTrap.what: A bystander has a belt cinched around the thigh as a venous tourniquet
venousTourniquetTrap.effect: bleed rate x1.3, leg purple and swollen
venousTourniquetTrap.playerMust: Recognize it and replace it with a proper tourniquet
venousTourniquetTrap.note: Optional trap from section 6, included in the Oct 28 build.

backstory: He was riding home and some truck cut him off, he swerved and just slammed into the guardrail.

injuries.notes: Left thigh partial arterial laceration. Base 700 mL/min at MAP 93, pressure-scaled. Tourniquet in about 3 min keeps him out of Class IV.

conditionsNote: Oct 28 core set from OCT28_MEDICAL_ANSWERS item 8, modeled in oct28_conditions.json. The DRAFT conditions.json (sepsis and complex trauma) stays OUT of Bike down.

bystander.label: Witnessing driver holding a shirt on the wound
bystander.notes: Holding pressure until the player takes over or talks to them, then it spurts. A second bystander cinched a belt on the thigh (venous tourniquet trap).
